description: WHEN: writing an extension or customization -- generates ready-to-use X++ code. Triggers: 'génère un CoC', 'crée une extension', 'generate extension', 'write a CoC class', 'event handler pour', 'template pour'. Uses REAL metadata from the KB (actual field names, method signatures). 'coc' = Chain of Command class, 'table_extension' = extend table with fields/methods, 'event_handler' = pre/post event handler, 'job' = runnable class, 'find_method' = find/exist pattern. ALWAYS call get_object_details first to verify the object exists.

methodName.description: Optional: specific method name for CoC or event handler templates

name: generate_xpp_template
